device.description: 8-bit quad micropower rail-to-rail voltage-output DAC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: dac084s085.pdf (SNAS363F) p.3 (pin configuration and functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.7 (timing requirements), p.8 (Figure 1 serial timing), p.15 (power-on reset, power-down modes, Table 1), p.16 (serial interface), p.17 (input shift register Figure 30)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A register written by OP = 00 (held until an update); power-on zero (p.15)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B register written by OP = 00 (held until an update); power-on zero (p.15)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C register written by OP = 00 (held until an update); power-on zero (p.15)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D register written by OP = 00 (held until an update); power-on zero (p.15)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: code driving VOUTA; power-on zero (p.15 power-on reset)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: code driving VOUTB; power-on zero (p.15 power-on reset)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: code driving VOUTC; power-on zero (p.15 power-on reset)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: code driving VOUTD; power-on zero (p.15 power-on reset)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: PD: powered down by OP1 OP0 = 11 until the next write; TERM: A1 A0 of that frame (00/11 Hi-Z, 01 2.5 kohm, 10 100 kohm, Table 1)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: OP1 OP0 = 00: write the register of the addressed DAC, outputs not updated

commands.name: WRITE_UPDATE
commands.note: OP1 OP0 = 01: write the addressed DAC and update the outputs of all DACs

commands.name: WRITE_ALL
commands.note: OP1 OP0 = 10: write every DAC register and update all outputs (address bits ignored)

commands.name: POWER_DOWN
commands.note: OP1 OP0 = 11: power down all outputs; A1 A0 select the termination (Table 1); DAC registers kept

pages: p.3 (pin configuration and functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VA 2.7-5.5 V, digital inputs 0-5.5 V regardless of VA), p.7 (timing requirements), p.8 (Figure 1 serial timing), p.15 (power-on reset, power-down modes, Table 1), p.16 (serial interface), p.17 (input shift register Figure 30)
notModeled: VOUTx, VREFIN and the resistor strings (analog); the power-down output terminations are stored in CTRL.TERM only
wake-up time 6-39 us, settling time 4.5 us max
variants: Pin-compatible 10/12-bit versions DAC104S085 / DAC124S085 are separate datasheets. VSSOP-10 (DGS) and WSON-10 (DSC) share the pin numbering.
